verdict.rationale: The open-source Orama JS library lets code create a database with an indexing schema, add documents with insert/insertMultiple, and run full-text, vector and hybrid searches, all programmatically with no dashboard involved. Orama Cloud also ships an auto-configured MCP server per project for agent access to data, plus official JS/Python/Rust SDKs. missing for 10: evidence that Cloud index/data-source creation and ingestion can be done via API or MCP rather than the web interface, an official CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (probes 404), MCP tool coverage beyond querying data, independent hands-on corroboration of an agent-driven end-to-end flow.
